reply.text:
I can't clear you medically, and I won't guess at it. Whether it's safe for you in particular is one for your doctor, so run it by them first, especially if you have any heart, joint or blood pressure issues or take regular medication.

Plenty of people start lifting in their seventies and beyond. Strength work is one of the better things to build at any age, and it starts lighter and slower than most people expect: simple movements, weights you can control, and plenty of rest between sessions.

Once you have the go-ahead, tell me how many days a week you can train and where you'll be lifting, and I'll set up a beginner program for you to check and confirm.
